tool_calls.code:
import pandas as pd
df = pd.read_csv('daily_cost_2.csv')
g = df.groupby(['SubAccountName','ServiceName'])['BilledCost']
stats = g.agg(['mean','median','std','max','min'])
print(stats)
# z-score per group
df['mean'] = df.groupby(['SubAccountName','ServiceName'])['BilledCost'].transform('mean')
df['std'] = df.groupby(['SubAccountName','ServiceName'])['BilledCost'].transform('std')
df['z'] = (df['BilledCost'] - df['mean']) / df['std']
top = df.sort_values('z', ascending=False).head(10)
print(top[['ChargePeriodStart','SubAccountName','ServiceName','BilledCost','mean','std','z']])
